Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.ott

Class RequestOneTimeCodeUseCase

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.ott.RequestOneTimeCodeUseCase
@Service @Transactional public class RequestOneTimeCodeUseCase extends Object
Sends a one-time code to a user, by e-mail or SMS.

The request is enumeration-safe: for an unknown identifier, a disabled account or an account without a verified address for the channel nothing is stored or sent, yet the same result is returned and a code is still generated and hashed, so the work done is alike. The code is never delivered inside this transaction: an e-mail is requested through an EmailCodeRequested event and an SMS through SendSmsOneTimeCodeUseCase, which records its cost and publishes an SmsRequested event; both are handled after the transaction commits and off the request thread, so no remote call holds a database connection and the latency of the mail server or the SMS gateway cannot tell an existing account from an unknown one. A refused SMS (country, budget) is not reported to the caller.

A new code replaces the previous one of the same binding and user (the repository saves one active code per binding and username). Magic links are not handled here: they use the framework's token service.
